case.summary: Automated monitoring flagged card-not-present transaction 3445840 on card C03237-K1 after the fraud model scored it at 0.991. Investigation identified a burst of three unauthorized online purchases totaling $299.92 between November 7 and November 10, 2016, originating from region 264. The primary transacting device, D003615, is an established fraud hub associated with twelve confirmed fraud cases and an extreme fraud lift across multiple compromised cards. Furthermore, card C03237-K1 and this specific holder profile were previously compromised by the same device in closed case CC-5231. The transactions are confirmed as card-not-present fraud, prompting card blocking and filing of a regulatory report.

sar.narrative: This report details unauthorized card-not-present activity on card C03237-K1 associated with customer C03237. Between November 7, 2016, and November 10, 2016, three suspicious online purchases for product R totaling $299.92 were executed in billing region 264. The episode commenced on November 7, 2016, with transaction 3438063 for $99.95 initiated via new device D006648. On November 10, 2016, transactions 3445840 ($99.94) at 03:12:21 UTC and 3445843 ($100.03) at 03:15:31 UTC were conducted in rapid succession via device D003615, an iOS device running iOS 11.2.5 on Mobile Safari (2436x1125). The bank's second-generation fraud detection model scored transaction 3445840 at 0.991, which has a 92.1% historical fraud rate. Device D003615 is an established fraud hub identified in twelve prior confirmed fraudulent cases, including closed case CC-5231 involving this same card on October 24, 2016. Shared origin analysis revealed device D003615 generated an extreme fraud lift of 19.94 across nine cards within a seven-day window. This activity directly links card C03237-K1 to five other concurrently compromised cards: C02716-K2, C04661-K1, C06147-K2, C06374-K1, and C09530-K1. The reuse of compromised identity attributes and rapid consecutive transactions of approximately $100 demonstrate coordinated card-not-present fraud. The bank has blocked card C03237-K1 to prevent additional exposure and placed the connected cards on heightened monitoring.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped pursuant to policy section 6 because the fraud probability reached a decisive 0.97 supported by multiple independent pieces of incriminating evidence, meaning further inquiry would not change the decision.
